response: Visceral adipose tissue (VAT) area measurement at a single level, specifically 3 cm above the lower margin of the L3 vertebra, can indeed represent visceral adipose tissue volume. This measurement is feasible and can reflect changes in VAT volume and body weight. In fact, research suggests that VAT area at this specific location can best reflect interval changes in VAT volume and body weight, making it a suitable choice for measurement. Therefore, a single-level measurement can be a reliable and effective way to assess visceral adipose tissue volume.
